data.title: AWS Recertification
data.description: AWS Certifications are valid for three years. To maintain your AWS Certified status, we require you to periodically demonstrate your continued expertise though a process called recertification. Find more information about AWS recertification process.
data.content:
For all recertification options—renewal and maintenance—time is extended based on the date of completion of that recertification action. For example, if you renewed by retaking the exam, three years are added from the date you completed that exam. Similarly, for maintenance, one year is added from the date you completed maintenance activities. 

AWS Cloud Quest: Recertify Cloud Practitioner allows certified individuals holding the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner to maintain active certification status. Certified individuals are eligible to complete AWS Cloud Quest: Recertify Cloud Practitioner when their AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification is due to expire within 6 months.

Completing this recertification option will extend the certification validity for 3 years. [Sign in to AWS Skill Builder for more FAQs](https://explore.skillbuilder.aws/pages/62/support%23awscloudquestrecertify).

You can find more answers to certification questions [here](https://aws.amazon.com/certification/faqs/).

You must have an active certification that is within 90 days of expiration and an active subscription to AWS Skill Builder (Monthly, Annual, or Team).
